name: notam-relay
description: Cloudflare Worker: scrapes the IAA NOTAM page every 15 minutes and serves notams.json for OpenEFB

scripts.publish-local: wrangler kv key put --binding NOTAM_KV --remote notams.json --path .data/notams.json && wrangler kv key put --binding NOTAM_KV --remote meta.json --path .data/meta.json
